name: Tsuyuzuki Mau
source:
Hayuru's younger sister. A girl who cares deeply for her sister, yet wears an expressionless face that makes it difficult to discern her thoughts.

She is also Nariyuki's student, though she is so intelligent she never needed a tutor in the first place.

Day after day, she torments Nariyuki with cruel, cutting words that pierce the heart.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=698944]getchu[/url]]
